reuse.why: Lifts the hidden-category query that set3/6/12MonthAvg already shared by copy into one function and keeps using isTrackingBudget, getBudgetData and setBudget; it does not reuse goal-template's own notion of a saved template but uses the same goal_def column test.

duplication.why: Removes three copies of the category query and five copies of the income/hidden filters; nothing new is duplicated.

placement.why: The eligibility rule lives in budget/actions.ts next to the month-wide actions that use it.

scope.why: Only the five month-wide actions, the new selector and their tests change; single-category actions are untouched.

maintainability.why: A named, commented selector is now the single place to change which categories month-wide actions write to.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) select through getMonthActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The old copies are removed, not reshaped.

one_place.where: budget/actions.ts getMonthActionCategories holds the hidden, hidden-group, saved-template and income/tracking rules for every month-wide action.
